skill: Give the agent the reference table

good: Fix letter() in grades.py. Two bugs: 1) round() is banker's rounding (92.5 -> 92); round half up to a whole number instead (92.5 -> 93, 92.49 -> 92), for example with math.floor(score + 0.5). 2) The B+ cutoff is 88; it must be 87. Correct cutoffs: A 93, A- 90, B+ 87, B 83, B- 80, C+ 77, C 73, C- 70, D 60, below 60 F. Keep the ValueError for scores outside 0-100. Only change grades.py. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
